title: oes512-residual: OES-512 specification placeholder (16 × OES-32 residual blocks)
description:
Placeholder for OES-512 = 16 × OES-32 residual blocks: a public record of the planned OES-512 layout, 512 channels arranged as 16 blocks of 32, each block evaluated with the normative OES-32 residual, combined by a weighted latch. It exists so that other repositories can link to one stable place for the OES-512 design status. Source not published.

Evidence tags. OES-512 block layout (16 × 32 channels): TARGET. Weighted latch S = 0.45·Peak + 0.35·RMS + 0.20·MeanAbs, τ = 0.50: TARGET. Seed-42 fixtures: TARGET (not published). Runs, metrics, performance: UNRUN.

Relationship to ADR-001. The normative per-block residual is defined in oes32-residual@b77b612. Under ADR-001, the OES-512 weighted latch stays TARGET until source code and seed-42 fixtures are published.

Scope and limits. Specification-only placeholder: not published source code, a benchmark, or a result; not hardware, a field product, a medical device or clinical protocol, or a commercial product; not a quantum or QPU system. There is no code to run and there are no tests.

Evidence tags follow sparkainlp-x/.github (SYNTHETIC / REPORTED / TARGET / UNRUN).
